owned_invariants: The view never shows a number the core did not return.

score.level_basis: View model with cancellable async commands and property-change plumbing: orchestrates loading, running, saving and verifying, turns expected failures into status, and lets unexpected ones reach the fail-closed handler.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Summary values are shown exactly as the core spelled them; file and core failures become status text.
basis.G3: Typed failures: every core failure becomes CoreException with a CoreErrorKind (RULE_CS_002 checks run after deserialisation; no null-forgiving operator in runtime code, enforced by a scan); async methods take and forward CancellationToken (CA2016 as error); disposables are disposed (CA2000/CA1816 as error). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit tests, view-model tests with a scripted client, and contract tests against the real Python core. Three mutants in the property-change plumbing survive. Mutation R = 4/5 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Cyclomatic complexity from lizard and CA1502 (threshold 10, error at build); nesting from the brace estimate. Cognitive complexity is not measured for C#, so A is not claimed. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 5, cognitive None, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
